review: Request: Wren asked for a learnable practical method that reduces spoilage of gathered edible roots, with explicit material requirements and measurable results, noting three gathered roots, mild spring conditions, no preservation equipment and unowned fallen branches nearby. World Agent decision: develop (learning 2) a general air-exposure food-preservation trial with an equipment-free whole-food mode, parameterized by an owned food stack, quantity, an accessible placement or existing support and start/inspect/turn/stop modes; it must reuse any equivalent handler, integrate a deterministic drying, rewetting and contamination update with the existing decay and, where required properties are unavailable, deliver tracked intact-food exposure with a decay comparison and preservation unverified, without invented water loss, shelf-life extension, safety, free equipment or reward. Registry check: the ex19 scope installs only foundation-forest, foundation-open and the expression foundation, none of which implements continuing exposure; no earlier exposure or drying package could be reused unchanged (ex14 controlled-food-processing-trial@1 has learning 3 and states that no food moisture model exists, which is false here; ex14 air-dry-food@1 is a first release that reports the missing model; ex10 measured-food-preservation@1 and the collective-ex12 root and small drying packages are bound to their tray, sheet and root representations and scopes). Implemented: a new package food-air-exposure-trial@1 (scope long-ex19, built by a reusable foodAirExposurePackage(id, scope) factory) with a simplified but real mechanism over the installed general food water representation (foodWaterSurfaceArea, foodWaterExpose and foodWaterRead, with the unchanged ex10 exchange and its decay integration in the environment) and the existing paid-work and escrow helpers (workCreate, workPay, workAllocations, workReserve, workStop), openRemember and base pickup. Modes and costs: start (one round, 1 + 0.5 energy per exposed whole unit, paid through workPay) separates whole units of the actor's own unspoiled, untreated berry or root stack (or food whose water composition is already represented) and lays them unowned on a ground footprint within hand reach (default the actor's position) or on an existing reachable object marked as a food surface, after the representation's real checks (inside the world, firm ordinary ground rather than water, wet bank or waterlogged ground, unobstructed, one sample per surface); an optional controlQuantity from the same stack stays carried and reserved in ordinary handling; inspect (one round, 0.2 energy, within reach of the batch) records elapsed rounds, quantities, decay at placement and now, decay per round for batch and control, their difference and rain rounds as an unverified personal record; stop (one round, no energy) settles the trial, releases the control once and leaves the batch lying, to be taken back with base pickup at its own cost; every failed precondition throws before any charge, so nothing is spent. Effects: the batch receives the representation's water record and then follows its unchanged per-round rules: whole food loses no water, rain on the uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water, and decay continues at the ordinary rate for the temperature where the food lies and is never reset, so no dryness, preservation or safety status can be reached and all three stay unverified; nutrition, toxicity and solids are unchanged; food quantity is conserved across parent, batch and control. The trial record persists batch, control, placement, readings, rain rounds and last update, and exposure continues unattended without charge; partial removal by anyone reduces the batch, full removal or spoilage under the existing rule ends the trial and releases the control, and death ends it with the control dropped under the existing death rules while the batch stays exposed. Events: air-exposure-placed, air-exposure-inspected, air-exposure-rained-on (when wetting begins), air-exposure-reduced, air-exposure-removed, air-exposure-spoiled, air-exposure-control-spoiled, air-exposure-stopped and air-exposure-interrupted, each with actor, trial, batch and placement references, tick and ground-stack view metadata (placement, intact form, state, rain-wet surface only when rain landed, preservation unverified), plus the representation's own preservation-progress event, declared as the representation requires; visualComponents is empty. Modeling assumptions: the representation's version-1 water fractions (root 0.75, berry 0.85) are model assumptions, and other foods without a represented composition are refused rather than given one; a ground footprint of 0.04 area per whole unit (about 0.2 x 0.2 each); only whole, unopened food is exposed, with no cutting, cooking, fire, salt or construction; there is no turn mode, because the representation has no orientation or contact-face state and a turn would cost energy with no represented effect; relocation is stop, pickup and a new start; one open trial per person; a support is any actual reachable food-surface object, since objects carry no ownership, and the nearby fallen branches are neither used nor consumed; food lying in the world is unowned under the ordinary world rule, so anyone may pick it up and the trial records who took it; contamination from ground contact is not represented and is reported as not assessed; spoiled food is removed by the existing rule, which has no separate waste output; water content is not reported because no weighing or moisture reading is made, while the representation's preservation-progress event keeps carrying its exchange temperature, air humidity and area as it already does; start energy is charged for exposed units only, because the control is not handled; no practice milestone, information gain, satisfaction or comfort is granted (records are unverified and the practice evidence is a placement event without a qualified flag); destructive probes on the exposed batch keep the probe's own costs. This is not a first release: the specification is self-consistent and explicitly allows tracked intact-food exposure with a decay comparison where drying properties are unavailable, and the mechanism has real costs, real effects on world state and observable events.
